# Eraya

> Handcrafted jewellery for women — rings, earrings, necklaces, bangles and more. Adorn your story.

Eraya is an online jewellery boutique offering handcrafted pieces designed for everyday elegance and special occasions.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured collections, new arrivals, and brand story.
- [Catalogue](/catalogue): Browse the full jewellery collection.
- [About](/about): The Eraya story and craftsmanship philosophy.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the Eraya team.
- [FAQ](/faq): Frequently asked questions about products, orders, and care.
- [Care Guide](/care): How to care for your jewellery.
